name: Decision dialog
author: Brett
description: One dialog for everything that needs Brett's decision (decision@1). Whenever something goes to UI Review he gets a notification and the dialog pops up on whatever console screen he is on, without navigating away: the item's title, build, screenshots or options side by side (desktop + phone), with Pick option N / Approve, Reject, Request changes (with a note), Later and Open in UI Review (only navigates when tapped). The same dialog takes the other decisions: veto countdowns, approvals, confirms, model upgrades, merge clashes, keys needed, passes; each source registers its buttons (types.json or its own), one queue, several waiting stack with a counter. Answered from the dialog, REST, MCP, the CLI or voice ('pick option 2', 'approve it'); Settings → Plugins → Decision dialog chooses which types pop up and which notify. Capability decisions@1 for other plugins.

items.title: Decision types and their buttons
items.description: Every kind of decision the dialog takes (UI Review, veto, approval, confirm, model upgrade, merge clash, key needed, pass, other) with its default buttons and whether it pops up.

items.title: Decisions waiting for Brett
items.description: The decisions waiting for Brett (newest first), or answered / withdrawn / all ones, optionally one type only; each with its id, title, build, options, buttons and whether it pops up now. Voice: 'what's waiting for me'.

items.title: Read one decision
items.description: One decision by id: what it is, its screenshots and options, its buttons and its answer once given.

items.title: Raise a decision for Brett
items.description: A source raises (or refreshes, same source + ref) a decision: it notifies Brett and pops up the decision dialog on his console. type, title, body, build, app, ref, handler (the capability that takes the answer), shots, options, buttons, openAction.

items.title: Brett's answer to a decision
items.description: Brett's answer to one decision: id (or 'latest', or its place in the queue, 1 = newest), button (approve, reject, changes, deny, approve-now, shelve … as the decision lists them, or pick with option N). Voice: 'pick option 2', 'approve it'. Only his own tap, his own words through AmberX or an axHub approval may call it; a session never answers for him.

items.title: Ask again later
items.description: Snoozes one decision's pop-up for some minutes (default from the settings); it stays in the queue and the counter.

items.title: A source takes a decision back
items.description: The source no longer needs the decision (decided elsewhere, ran, gone): it leaves the queue and its notification goes.

items.title: Which decision types pop up and notify
items.description: Per decision type: does it pop up the dialog, does it send a notification; and how many minutes Later waits.

items.title: Choose which decision types pop up and notify
items.description: Turns the pop-up and the notification on or off per decision type, and sets how many minutes Later waits.
